schemaDisposition: Records follow the user-specified decision_inspect typed envelope {id,actor,date,closedFlags,flags,state,scopes,controls}. The probability adapter accepts a projection with id, actor, date, flags, state, scopes, and optional eventTargets; it rejects controls and closedFlags. A one-scenario projection reached the subsequent source-required validation, but the all-scenario projection has not yet completed an MCP evaluation.
fixtureDisposition: All numeric values beyond the explicit RF_POLICY_01 example are representative test controls chosen to instantiate qualitative spec prose. They are not gameplay decisions, balance targets, actual campaign snapshots, or proof. Identifiers are source-spelled where verified. Unbound facts appear in coverageByScenario.unresolved rather than being silently omitted.
